Measures
In this Attachment and social anxiety dataset, there are responses to three scales. The Social Interaction Anxiety Scale which measures individual’s anxiety during social interaction (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9). The subscale of the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale which measures individual’s anxiety in relationships (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.94). Lastly, the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale which measures self-worth (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
To correctly assess responses, items 5, 9, and 11 from the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale, and items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 from the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale were reverse keyed.
